mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments (post_id, author_id, parent_id, content, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{postId}, #{authorId}, #{parentId}, #{content}, 0, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, post_id as postId, author_id as authorId, parent_id as parentId, content, is_deleted as isDeleted, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM comments WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT c.id, c.post_id, c.author_id, c.parent_id, c.content, c.is_deleted, c.created_at, c.updated_at, u.id as user_id, u.email, u.username, u.role, u.status, u.last_login_at, u.created_at as user_created_at, u.updated_at as user_updated_at FROM comments c LEFT JOIN users u ON c.author_id = u.id WHERE c.id = #{id}

SELECT id, post_id as postId, author_id as authorId, parent_id as parentId, content, is_deleted as isDeleted, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM comments WHERE post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY created_at ASC

SELECT id, post_id as postId, author_id as authorId, parent_id as parentId, content, is_deleted as isDeleted, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM comments WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at ASC

SELECT id, post_id as postId, author_id as authorId, parent_id as parentId, content, is_deleted as isDeleted, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM comments WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at ASC

SELECT id, post_id as postId, author_id as authorId, parent_id as parentId, content, is_deleted as isDeleted, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM comments WHERE author_id = #{authorId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND is_deleted = 0
